title: Visual convention register (synthesis output)
description: The project-level machine-readable half of the survey (spec L-3), keyed by canonical convention id, and ALSO the build-handoff index standing decision #6 names. SHAPE ONLY — whether a row characterises its convention faithfully is the reviewing twin's judgment. Rows are copied from extract records; a row with no record behind it is the defect the synthesis validator's --extracts cross-check exists to catch.

extract_count.description: How many extract records this register was built from — the arithmetic the --extracts cross-check reconciles.

token_format.description: Pinned (L-4). The format stabilised 2025-10-28; pinning makes a later revision a visible change rather than silent drift.

coverage_receipt.description: Provable absence. A survey that searched and found nothing must be distinguishable from one that could not search, and that distinction has to survive into the project-level artifact — not just the per-request working files.

cause.description: Required in prose for anything other than `ran`: WHY the angle produced nothing. A vacated angle with no cause is a zero-hit wearing a disguise.

unadmitted.description: Candidates the admission rule (L-7) refused — a listicle assertion with no upstream corpus. Counted, never silently dropped (#20).

skipped.description: Extract records whose outcome was `skipped` (the relevance bail). These have records on disk; they simply carry no convention.

conventions.description: One row per extracted convention, keyed by canonical id. An empty array is a legitimate result when every angle vacated — the coverage receipt is what makes it readable.

record.description: The extract record filename this row was copied from, so every claim is traceable to the file that made it.

tokens.description: The source system's tokens, copied VERBATIM from that record's ```dtcg body block (L-3, W2-Q1). Present only on design-system rows. Never a blend across systems — merging is a synthesis judgment that drifts from its sources, and the downstream skill authors THIS project's system from the evidence.
